nodes.label: Profile Stats Cache Invalidation Flow
nodes.rationale: Server Actions updating likes/dislikes/views must update MySQL via Drizzle transactions with row locks (.for('update')) where appropriate, then invalidate the Redis live cache via invalidateLiveStatsCache and trigger ISR revalidatePath, keeping DB, cache, and static pages consistent.

nodes.label: Client Live Hydration (ISR 30-day)
nodes.rationale: Public profile pages use ISR with a 30-day window; viewer-specific state and live stats are fetched client-side via /api/profile/me and /api/profile/live so static pages stay cacheable while showing fresh per-viewer data.

nodes.label: Preview Panel Sync
nodes.rationale: All customize pages must render DashboardProfilePreview with overrides from useCustomizeProfile(), pad right by --preview-width, and wire SaveBar to hasChanges/clearOverrides so the settings UI and live preview stay in sync.

nodes.label: Atomic Side-Folder Build Swap
nodes.rationale: Builds into .next-build (NEXT_DIST_DIR) so the live .next keeps serving traffic, then mv's it into place only after the build passes. set -e halts on failure, leaving the old working .next intact for rollback safety.

nodes.label: Deploy Concurrency Control
nodes.rationale: Serializes deploys via concurrency group 'deploy-production' with cancel-in-progress:false so two back-to-back pushes to main don't build over each other on the same box.

nodes.label: ISR Cache Seeding
nodes.rationale: Copies the old .next/cache into .next-build/cache before building because that is where the 30-day ISR cache lives; seeding keeps the build incremental. Also drops stale .next/types that would otherwise break the build typecheck.
